provenance: Five user-observed same-seed approximately 47–49 minute canonical match exports after merged PR182; descriptive exploratory only, NOT independent validation

method.continuous_owner_episode: consecutive sampledPositioning rows with identical nonempty ball.ownerId
method.team_attack_direction: home attacks positive X and away attacks negative X during these first halves; therefore moving toward home goal is negative X for home and positive X for away
method.retreat_metric: positive own-goal longitudinal X displacement; lateral distance not part of threshold
method.qualifying_episode: retreat > 6 m AND observed first-to-last time >= 3 s; sampling may split or miss true carries
limitations: ownerId remains assigned while the player has the ball; the samples are not a full physical touch or velocity replay
forwardPassingOptions is a geometric observer estimate, not confirmed feasible candidate or selected action
team-mate inactivity was observed visually by user; individual team-mate velocities and action ranks are not supplied by sampledPositioning
episodes after alternative decisions are different match trajectories, so cross-policy counts are not isolated causal effects
